title: Quotient and remainder as text
description: Divide a by b with the quotient q rounded toward zero (the fraction is dropped) and let r = a - b*q be the remainder. Return the text "q r": the quotient, one space, the remainder. For example a = -7, b = 2 gives "-3 -1", and a = 7, b = -2 gives "-3 1". b is never 0 and may be negative.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states truncation toward zero in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
